hello_subtitle: UI/UX sandbox. No database, mock API only. Dev builds only.
hello_i18n_desc: Default locale lives in project.inlang/settings.json; currency and time zone in src/lib/config.ts.
hello_api_desc: GET /api/hello returns fixed JSON with no database call. Its message is translated on the server.
savebar_discard_desc: All unsaved changes will be lost. This can't be undone.
savebar_leave_desc: You have unsaved changes. Leaving will discard them.
demo_savebar_desc: Edit a field and the bar slides in. Try Ctrl/⌘+S, Discard, the link below, and the browser's Back button.
demo_invalid_desc: Locks Save without hiding the bar.
demo_fail_desc: The changes stay unsaved and an error toast appears.
demo_form_desc: Example form state, held in a Draft.
demo_notify_desc: Send a digest when something changes.
demo_save_fail: Save failed. Your changes are still here.
demo_shell_desc: Placeholder page inside the shell. Try the sidebar, the breadcrumb, Ctrl/⌘+/ to search, Ctrl/⌘+B to collapse, and a phone-sized window.
demo_shell_slow: Reports load slowly on purpose, so you can see the top progress bar and the spinner on the row you clicked.
demo_shell_unlisted: This page isn't in the nav, so the breadcrumb is empty.
table_stale: The list below hasn't been refreshed.
table_select_all: Select all rows on this page
table_bulk_confirm_desc: {count} selected items will be processed. This can't be undone.
demo_table_desc: Sort by clicking a header. Search, filter, pick dates, hide columns, select rows. Two tables: one in memory, one paged by a mock endpoint.
demo_table_memory_desc: 137 customers held in the page. Segments, bulk actions (Activate, Delete with confirm) and row actions.
demo_table_server_desc: One page at a time from /api/hello/customers. The first page came with the server render. Toggle slow or failing requests to see the loading and error states.
http_failed: The request failed. Please try again.
http_unreachable: Can't reach the server. Check your connection.
demo_forms_desc: The same schema validates in the browser and again on the server. Messages are translated; switch to ID to see them change.
demo_forms_api_desc: apiForm + SaveBar. Saves with PUT to /api/hello/profile, which re-validates with readJson. Try an empty name, a bad URL, 0 seats, or the email taken@example.test (only the server knows it's in use).
demo_forms_email_hint: taken@example.test is rejected by the server.
demo_forms_server_check: Send an invalid body to the server
demo_forms_server_check_result: The endpoint rejected it on its own, with the same messages:
demo_forms_email_taken: This email is already in use
demo_forms_action_desc: A plain <form> posting to ?/subscribe, validated by validateForm on the server. Enhanced with JavaScript, and still works with it turned off.
auth_login_desc: Welcome back. Sign in with your email and password.
auth_signup_desc: It takes less than a minute.
auth_too_many: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
auth_email_taken: An account with this email already exists.
app_start_desc: Pages under /app need a session. Add yours here; guard each with requirePermission when it needs more than a signed-in user.
app_profile_desc: How you appear to others in this workspace.
app_email_fixed: Your sign-in email can't be changed here.
app_password_desc: You'll stay signed in on this device.
app_revoke_sessions: Sign out of all other devices
app_settings_desc: Only administrators see this page; others get a 404.
